question: At Indo Myanmar border which hills adjoin the Mizo Hills and Manipur Hills of the Eastern Highlands of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chin.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Chin Hills **are a** mountainous area** in **northwest Myanmar,** **running parallel** to the **border with India.**
 
• In a **mountain arc** that extends **northward from the Arakan Mountains **to the **Patkai Range,** they are the** largest and most central **segment.
 
• At the **Myanmar-India frontier**, the** Chin Hills** adjoin the** Mizo Hills** and the **Manipur Hills** of the** Purvachal, or Eastern Highlands,** of India.
 
• The** Myittha River** on the **east **and the** headstreams of the Kaladan River** on the** west** define the boundaries of the Chin Hills, a tangle of forested hill ranges with** humid valley bottoms **and **cooler slopes** that are divided by **deep, narrow gorges.****​​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Dongkya:**

 
 
• The **lower Himalayan mountain range** known as the Dongkya or Dongkhya range serves as **Sikkim's eastern border.**
 
 
 
• **Toba Kakar:**
 
 
• The **Toba Kakar Mountains** are a **southern branch** of the Himalayas in the **Balochistan locale of Pakistan**, close to the** fringe with Afghanistan.**
 
 
 
• **Khasi:**
 
 
• On the** Shillong Plateau** in the Indian state of** Meghalaya**, there is a** low mountain range** known as the Khasi Hills.
